name: Mohammad Ruhul Amin
contribution: As Engine Room Artificer of gunboat PNS Palash, he continued fighting during attack despite severe danger and was killed in action.
context: Naval operations in Khulna-Mongla theatre, December 1971.
impact: He became a symbol of naval courage and sacrifice in the Liberation War.
highlight: His final duty under fire became part of national military memory.
